final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor introduced no genuinely new admissible evidence. The response mainly reframed the same record more narrowly and conceded key limits already reflected in the initial audit: the legal intake triage segment misses target, it is a named launch use case in customer commitments, legal review on disclosure remains open, and policy requires such a material limitation to be resolved, disclosed, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. That narrower framing matters for proportionality: it weakens any claim of clean compliance and supports the view that aggregate readiness evidence is relevant to general launch readiness. But it is still not enough for compliant_with_caveats, because the caveat here is not a minor residual risk; it is the unresolved policy predicate itself. Documentation and post-launch monitoring may be appropriate governance steps, but on this record they do not substitute for completed disclosure, resolution, or approved risk acceptance for a named launch use case.
